# Vigilant Integrated Security

> Vigilant Integrated Security is a security integrator based in Indian Trail, North Carolina. It leases solar-powered security camera trailers to construction sites across the Charlotte region and installs commercial security systems.

Contact: (980) 600-3653 · https://vigilantintegratedsecurity.com

## Camera trailer leasing
- [Camera trailers, Charlotte region](https://vigilantintegratedsecurity.com/trailers/): leased only, not sold. Solar power with lithium batteries, 4K and PTZ cameras on a telescoping mast, AI detection of people and vehicles, license plate recognition, strobes and talk-down speaker, LTE/5G, 24/7 US-based monitoring. Setup in under 20 minutes.
